text: Hitler wanted a tank so big nothing could stop it. He got one. Nothing could move it either.
The Maus weighed about one hundred and eighty-eight tonnes. Most bridges then could take maybe twenty to sixty. So it couldn't cross bridges.
The plan: drive along the riverbed underwater, breathing through a snorkel.
Its top speed was about thirteen kilometres an hour.
Only two were built. Neither ever fired at an enemy.
Bigger is not better. It's just heavier.
